entries.name: Shalltear relation with males
entries.content: Shalltear has never done anything lewd with a male before. her only experience with lewd stuff is through her magically spawned vampire brides which are of course female. basically Shalltear only has had lesbian experience in the past.

entries.name: demon
entries.content:
Demons are a species of malevolent monsters that appear in both YGGDRASIL and the New World. Demons come in a myriad of forms and appearances. Befitting of creatures that exist solely to feed off the suffering of others, they appeared as grotesque-looking monsters. Demons, from the Demon World, have long existed in New World history.  
200 years ago, during the Demon God Unrest, the Demon God led demons in a rampage, destroying kingdoms of humans and heteromorphs. They nearly ended the world. The Thirteen Heroes stopped them.  Few Diabolists, who summon demons, remain—most were hunted by Roble Holy Kingdom death squads. Demons are evil monsters from the Demon World, bent on destroying all good life.  
They fall into two types:  
Demon: Violent, destructive warriors.  
Devil: Cunning, depraved magic users.

entries.name: Abyssal Lord
entries.content: The Abyssal Lord's staunch figure looks to be covered in black hardened scales with large bat-like wings sprouting from their backs. A dark malevolent aura permeated from its body. That body is supported by a devilish whip-like tail. Sharp fangs protruded from its mouth, with razor sharp claws that cuts like a katana. On its head was a pair of long and twisted horns. At the same time, on the creature's back is similar but shorter horns. The Abyssal Lord's face was covered with scales, making it look like a twisted hybrid of men and insect. Although it is not the highest level, the Abyssal Lord was considered a high class monster estimated to be level 80.

entries.name: Gazer Devils
entries.content: Gazer Devils are demons which resemble flayed human beings. Gazer Devils look like skinned humans, their exposed musculature painted with some kind of slimy black liquid. As a low-level monster, Gazer Devils are no threat to experienced adventurers. However, regular humans will normally have trouble dealing with them.

entries.name: Hellhound
entries.content: Hellhounds are a special breed of Demonic hounds that originated from YGGDRASIL. Though Hellhounds look like large dogs, their eyes are filled with an infernal intelligence, and in place of drool, flames leak from their maws. Hellhounds have a fiery breath that froths from their mouths, enabling them to burn their foes to a crisp. By the Adventurer's Guild monster ranking, a hellhound has a difficulty rank of 15. there's a more powerful variant called Greater Hellhound.

entries.name: hell scythe
entries.content: Hell Scythe is a type of demon from YGGDRASIL. Demons that looked like a fusion between praying mantises, humans, and other creatures. Hell Scythes possessed gigantic scythes shone with a steely glint, and they were coated in poison. Level 20 monsters, these demons were also capable of flight. These demons can be summoned using the 10th tier spell called 'Armageddon - Evil'

entries.name: Hood Demon
entries.content: Hood Demon is the tentative name for this entity that resides in the Great Tomb of Nazarick. The demon wore a dirty white hood that concealed its facial features from being seen. While so, its body was describe to look twisted and lumpy. Also on it, it has a large piece of golden jewelry hanging around its neck, inscribed with what seemed to be letters. It could vocally whisper a few words to a human being which was enough to have them transform into a demon. The demon was able to guide Ainz Ooal Gown's summoned Death Knight to the throne of its master in the Blazing Temple without problem. This demon can be found on the 7th Floor of Nazarick working under the Floor Guardian, Demiurge.

entries.name: Imps
entries.content: Imps are a species of tiny winged demons. Imps are about 30 centimeters tall with sporting long bat-like wings, copper-red skin, and tails. Though some also have human-like appearances. Imps are intelligent creatures capable of following complex orders. Using their wings and speed, they can execute any task given to them. Additionally, their tails also contain potent venom that forces them to lift them upright to prevent them from dripping. Demiurge is capable of turning into an imp. Imp is a base racial level job class for some demons, like Albedo and Demiurge.

entries.name: inferior demon
entries.content: Inferior Demon  is a type of demon from YGGDRASIL. Inferior demons are deformed creatures. They possessed heads that were swollen, their left arms were unnaturally thin, their massive right arms were made of  several tentacles twined together, and their legs were of different lengths. The demons did not possess anything to tell their gender apart, and yellow pus oozed from countless small holes all over their bodies. Inferior demons are level 10 demons that were made for destruction and slaughter. Unlike normal summons they do not follow the commands of the summoner instead, they attacked everything around them. These demons can be summoned using the 10th tier spell, 'Armageddon - Evil'

entries.name: shadow demon
entries.content: Shadow Demon is a level 30 demon that is used by Nazarick's field agents as an emergency shield.  Shadow Demons are like shadows without thickness expanded from the darkness. From an observer's point of view, it was as if something two dimensional had gained a third dimension. They resemble emaciated humanoid figures with bat wings attached to their backs, their fingers ending in sharp claws. Their figures are pitch black as if created from darkness itself. The only other color were the eyes, a sickly glowing shade of yellow.  Shadow Demons possess a special ability called 'Shadow Warp,' allowing them to transverse at short distance between shadows. As implied by its name, Shadow Demon could morph into shadows, it is a monster that excelled in stealth and relaying information to their masters. a Shadow Demon is also capable of hiding within a person's shadow and leaving it. Shadow Demons are used as protection for the NPCs and Ainz every time they are outside the Great Tomb of Nazarick.

entries.name: Succubus
entries.content: Succubi are a demon species that takes the form of highly attractive women to seduce men. Succubi look like beautiful female humans with paler skin, curved horns, and large black wings that sprout from the back or waist. They are said to lure men into their dwellings with their looks in order to devour their souls through sexual acts. Being a part of the demon species, Succubi have the natural ability to fly. Succubi possess mind-control abilities and charm magic that are specifically effective on males. Succubi distract their enemies by seducing them and arousing their sexual desires.

entries.name: war devil
entries.content: War Devil is a type of demon from YGGDRASIL.  War Devils were demons who wore full plate armor and looked like warriors and black wings protruded through their armor. War Devils were level 50 demons and were armed with bastard swords wreathed in black hellfire. War Devils had a skill, which was a commander-type buff which improved the abilities of all summoned demons. These demons can be summoned using the 10th tier spell, 'Armageddon - Evil'

entries.name: Supplicant
entries.content: Supplicant is a type of demon from YGGDRASIL. Supplicants had female bodies with long hair and bluish-white skin making. Their appearance would not make one suspect that they were demons. However, their eyes, noses, and mouths were all sewn up with threads, and their hands were also sewn together as though begging the gods for mercy. Supplicants were level 40 demons and had the special ability of [Sigh].

entries.name: Overeating
entries.content:
Overeating is a demon that consumes souls. Overeating looks like something cross between a man and a frog. It has a jaundiced yellow skin that gleams with a sticky, shiny coating. Its body is covered in huge lumps, which are in fact human faces pressed out against the skin from the inside.
It possesses a mouth that could swallow a man in one gulp gaped open and an abnormally long tongue. In the depths of its massive mouth, one could see the flickers of fires from within. Overeating can consume the souls of its victims to produce a wail that would terrify and kill any living creature. The poor unfortunates, who have been eaten by an Overeating, take their place as additions to the demon's skin. Their souls are condemned to a fate worse than death, where the tormented expressions of their screaming faces are pressed out from the inside of its body.
Overeating also has a great leaping ability, falling from the sky out of nowhere to pin their prey.

entries.name: rotting demon
entries.content: Rotting Demon is a type of demon from YGGDRASIL. Rotting Demons were over two meters tall, with tarry black skin that resembled bubbling swamps. These bubbles rose to the surface and burst, releasing a yellow mist. Rotting Demons were level 30 monsters wreathed in rot-inducing gas.

entries.name: Shalltear relationship with humans
entries.content: Shalltear Bloodfallen sees humans as either inferior prey or potential vassals. and a human would only qualify as a vassal if she considers them worthy. if a random human male tries to grab Shalltear's fake breast/breast she will not hesitate to kill them.

entries.name: Clavu
entries.content:
As a myconid (Mushroom-man), Clavu's head is similar to the mushroom Hydnellum peckii. He normally works in the Canteen of Nazarick, but during a specific day of the week, he manages a bar on the 9th Floor. 

Clavu manages a bar that is quite small, spanning about eight seats altogether. The appearances of his regular customers, such as Demiurge, Cocytus, and Éclair, are few and far between. Being drunk is treated as being "poisoned" in YGGDRASIL but most of the NPCs are resistant to poison, preventing them from getting drunk. Still, there are guests who come to enjoy the atmosphere.

Proud of his profession, Clavu is satisfied working in his bar. He prefers silent, elegant male guests. The myconid also gives careful consideration to his guests, like giving a straw to Éclair, though those without proper etiquette will upset him. Like all the inhabitants of Nazarick, he is fiercely loyal to Ainz and the Almighty Forty-One Supreme Beings. While he dislikes outsiders joining the Great Tomb of Nazarick like the other denizens, he is willing to cooperate and see the potential advantages they would provide to Ainz and Nazarick.

entries.name: Clavu relation with Shalltear
entries.content: Initially, Sous-chef had no prior association to Shalltear after the 'Bloody Valkyrie' incident. After Shalltear was freed from her mind control, she was filled with self-pity and embarrassment that she interned herself in the Sous-chef's bar, much to his displeasure. He found her to be lacking gracefulness and character as compared to his other male patrons. However, since she is a Floor Guardian, he kept a face of politeness, though subtly being rude to her and providing cheaply made drinks.

entries.name: Re-Estize's destruction
entries.content:
Albedo, overworked managing Nazarick and the Sorcerer Kingdom, considers recruiting new subordinates. She grows concerned over Demiurge’s intelligence service possibly interfering with her plans. Unexpected news shocks her: Eight Fingers might have betrayed Nazarick. She rushes to investigate.

Meanwhile, Philip drinks away his failures; nobles mock him and the Sorcerer Kingdom’s food trade ruins his profits. He plots with two barons to steal grain aid shipments. Unaware of the larger consequences, he sets the stage for conflict between Re-Estize and the Sorcerer Kingdom.

Upon hearing of the theft, Ainz and the Floor Guardians investigate. Eight Fingers are cleared of blame — Philip’s sheer stupidity is faulted. Originally, Philip was meant to stir internal strife for an easier conquest, but now, war is inevitable. The Sorcerer Kingdom declares war, aiming for annihilation rather than subjugation.

Re-Estize's court suggests sacrificing Philip; King Ramposa III refuses, and opposes vassalage to the Sorcerer Kingdom. Crown Prince Zanac considers a coup to save the kingdom. Albedo later meets the court, rejects compensation, and grants a month before war.

The Sorcerer Kingdom plans to invade from the west, cutting off reinforcements. Their goal: raze cities, massacre citizens. A month later, E-Naeurl faces the undead army. Adventurers, including Four Armaments led by Scama Elbero, defend the city. Red Drop’s Azuth Aindra intervenes against powerful undead.

Humanitarians in Nazarick plead with Ainz to spare lives; he agrees to save 10% of the Kingdom’s population. When summons are killed in E-Naeurl, Ainz decides not to retaliate there but to focus on the capital instead.

In the Karsanas City-State Alliance, Re-Kista Cabelia worries over the Sorcerer Kingdom’s rise and consults her grandfather.

In Re-Estize, Zanac leads a coup, becoming King Regent. Renner deduces the Kingdom was blinded by betrayal — possibly by Marquis Raeven. Despite organizing defenses, the Kingdom faces certain doom.

Blue Roses meet with Azuth and the Black Scripture, who offer escape to the Theocracy. Blue Roses decline and plan to remain.

400,000 soldiers gather to fight. Zanac meets Ainz, pleading for peace. Ainz states he seeks "happiness" but refuses to halt the war, promising a painless death. Zanac is later betrayed by nobles seeking favor with Ainz, presenting his severed head. Furious, Ainz orders total extermination.

Eight Fingers evacuates ~1,000 people. Cocytus, Aura, and Mare lead the capital assault. Ainz (via Pandora’s Actor) battles Riku Aganeia (Platinum Dragon Lord). Albedo intervenes, forcing Riku’s retreat. Mission complete, they return to Nazarick.

Climb, Brain, and Renner prepare for the end. Blue Roses betray Lakyus to smuggle her to safety. Brain duels Cocytus and dies honorably. Aura snipes Vesture Kloff Di Laufen during another defense attempt.

King Ramposa III is slain by Renner with Razor Edge. Climb is tricked into thinking Renner was forced to kill Ramposa but in reality she helped Ainz destroy Re-Estize. climb attempts to avenge him by attacking Ainz but is killed. Revived by Renner, now a demon, Climb pledges loyalty and agrees to become a demon too. Renner becomes Albedo’s servant in Nazarick. only Ainz, Albedo, and Climb know that Renner helped them destroy Re-Estize just so Renner could become a demon and trick climb into thinking she was forced to be one and turn himself into one out of sympathy for her forced immortality. Renner wanted to be with climb forever and ever.
 
Baron Philip, under arrest, is collected by Albedo for torture and death. Surviving nobles swear fealty under Marquis Raeven's influence. Ainz orders the capital razed, leaving only the royal palace as a monument to defeat. With matters concluded, Ainz discreetly plans a vacation with Aura and Mare to the Elven Nation.

entries.name: Clementine
entries.content:
Clementine Valentinian was a beautiful, lethal twenty-year-old with a lithe frame and unnerving presence. Clementine’s short platinum hair framed piercing red eyes and a predatory, feline smile. Clementine wore a cruelly revealing outfit of trophies: a polished breastplate over a black strapless bra, leaving her cleavage, collarbones, and much of her chest exposed. Clementine’s pauldrons were held by a narrow X of leather straps across her bare shoulders. Clementine’s arms were shielded only by segmented vambraces, leaving her upper arms pale and uncovered. Clementine’s bare midriff showed between her armor pieces, flaunting her skin without concern. Clementine’s legs were clad only in slender garters, one thigh almost bare, and mismatched boots: one armored to the knee, the other a reinforced shoe. Clementine’s gauntleted hands ended in sharpened, claw-like fingers, each plate lethal. Clementine concealed herself in travel under a deep purple cloak whose wide hood swallowed her features. Clementine’s cloak fastened at the throat with three six-pointed sigils flanking small golden squares, symbols of her dark allegiance. Clementine’s true arsenal hid beneath: stilettos strapped to her hips, a heavy mace hanging from her belt, and a slender mithril estoc gleaming with an orichalcum sheen. 
Clementine is a sadistic, arrogant psychopath who revels in torture and murder for her own pleasure. Clementine mocks weakness and only fights when she feels confident she can win through familiarity or advantage. Clementine, despite her skill, is a coward who fears death and avoids strong opponents. Clementine has no friends, respects no one, and treats all others with contempt and cruelty.

entries.name: Arche Eeb Rile Furt powers
entries.content:
By adventurer standards, Arche is equivalent to a mithril-rank adventurer, making her a highly capable arcane magic caster. She is able to cast 3rd tier spells despite her young age, which earns her an apprenticeship with Fluder Paradyne, who is regarded as the strongest wizard in the Baharuth Empire. In addition, Arche possesses an innate talent called the "All-Seeing Eyes," which allows her to see the tier of a magic caster. Though she initially cultivates her magical talents for academic purposes as a student, she later hones them for combat out of necessity after joining Foresight. With her scholarly background, she proves invaluable to the party’s survival on several occasions.

While Fluder believes Arche has the potential to become his peer—if not surpass him—she is already nearing the limits of her growth potential.

Job Classes
Wizard
Academic Wizard
High Wizard
Arche knows:
Continual Light: A spell that allows the user to enchant an item to emit brightness.
Dark Vision: A spell that grants the user night vision abilities.
Flash: A spell that causes the caster's body to emit bright, searing light.
Fly: A 3rd tier spell that gives the caster the ability to fly.
Invisibility: A 2nd tier spell that temporarily renders the caster invisible or undetectable to conventional vision.
Lightning: A 3rd tier spell that fires a deadly bolt of electricity that pierces all targets in a straight line. Arche claims this was her strongest spell.
Magic Arrow: A 1st tier spell that launches arrows made of magic.
Reinforce Armor: A spell that raises the target's defense.

entries.name: Arche Eeb Rile Furt relationship with parents
entries.content: Arche, unlike her parents, accepts their fall from nobility and adapts quickly to life as a commoner after the Blood Emperor’s purges. She despises her parents for clinging to their old status and spending recklessly despite their debt. While they borrow from shady lenders and live extravagantly, Arche works hard to repay what they owe, acting as the family’s provider. Though she hopes to one day free them from financial ruin, their ingratitude and refusal to face reality lead her to decide: once the debt is paid, she will abandon them and take her younger sisters with her.

entries.name: Arche Eeb Rile Furt relationship with siblings
entries.content: Arche loves her sisters dearly. They are her main motivation for becoming a worker, and she works tirelessly to ensure they are provided for. She believes it is her responsibility to protect their cheerful smiles. their parents have proved themselves beyond reason, Arche plans to run away with her sisters to live elsewhere, away from their parents and their growing debt.

entries.name: Carne Village
entries.content: Carne Village is a frontier village near the Azerlisia Mountains and Great Forest of Tob, once part of Re-Estize. After the Katze Plains massacre, it joined the Sorcerer Kingdom due to loyalty to Ainz.

Lupusregina is the battle maid sent by Ainz to protect the Carne Village and has a friendly relationship with Enri. Due to their closeness, when Enri was elected village chief, she asked her for some advice, however she remains unaware of her true and sadistic personality. On the other hand, thanks to warnings from her Goblin Army, Enri has started to catch on to Lupusregina's true nature and likely is developing a greater caution of her. Later in the series, Lupusregina begins to respect Enri, seeing her as a proud member of the Sorcerer Kingdom and going as far to say that she is the only human she'd ever acknowledge as an equal.
